chunks: Humayd, from Ibn Sama'a, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Muawiya ibn Wahb, from Ubayd ibn Zurara, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the woman whose husband dies while she is his wife, and he has not entered (consummated marriage) with her, he (peace be upon him) said: 'She is in the status of the divorced woman whom the husband has not entered with. If he had specified a dower for her, then she has half of it, and she inherits him. And if he had not specified a dower for her, then there is no dower for her, and she inherits him.' I said: 'And the waiting period (iddah)?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Refrain from this (question).'
ai.seo_question: What is the dower and inheritance status of a wife whose husband dies before consummating the marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the status of a woman widowed before consummation, equating her to a divorced woman who was not entered with, thereby entitling her to half the specified dower and full inheritance. The Imam’s response to the question regarding her waiting period ('kuff') reflects the scholarly principle of sufficiency, as the waiting period for such a woman is universally agreed upon as four months and ten days, making further elaboration unnecessary in this context.

en.hubeali: Humeyd, from Ibn Sama’at, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan, from Muawiya Bin Wahab, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the woman widowed from her husband, and he had not slept with her. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She is at a status of the divorced woman who had not been slept with, If a dower had been specified for her, so for her is half, and she would inherit him; and if a dower had not been specified for her, so there is no dower for her, and she would inherit him’. I said, ‘And the waiting period?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Refrain from this’.
en.sarwar: 9. Humayd has narrated from ibn Sama‘ah from Ahmad ibn al-Hassan from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahab from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurarah who has said

the following: “About the case of a woman whose husband dies before going to bed with her, abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘She is like a divorced woman with whom he has not gone to bed. If mahr (dower) is set for her she deserves one-half of it, otherwise, she does not have the right to demand mahr (dower) but she has the right to inherit.’ I asked about waiting period. He (the Imam) said, ‘Do not ask about it.’”
